description:
Discover one filing event type across companies using linked filing dates within the last seven Beijing calendar days including today. Dates omitted use this whole window; one omitted end uses the corresponding allowed boundary. Partial overlap is clamped; reversed or wholly outside dates are errors. effective_since/effective_until report the actual dates. A new filing mentioning an old case qualifies without claiming new case progress.

Call this for market-wide recent filings. Do NOT use it for a full company state. Each event appears once, newest matching filing date first. matched_filing contains the qualifying filing id, date and its own PDF link; root source_pdf_url and phase describe current event context, not historical state at the selected date. phase filters current stage. At most 100 events per page. Pass cursor to continue; only non-null cursor means another page. Omit dates/phase on continuation or repeat their effective values; changing filters requires a fresh call. event_type must remain the same; limit/locale may change. matched_count counts the whole frozen window, so truncated can remain true on the last page. Windows that move outside the allowed dates fail with cursor_expired; restart without cursor. Results are a dynamic view, not a snapshot: new filings, stage changes or merges can move events between pages. Poll from the first page and deduplicate by aevt_. Empty results mean no matches after this position, not an empty database. coverage_since is data coverage, not permission to scan history. For a known company/entity use get_entity_state; for a known event use get_event_with_context.

cursor.description: Return the previous cursor unchanged to continue within its frozen dates.
cursor.title: Cursor

event_type.description: Which filing type to scan. Call list_coverage for the current scope.
event_type.title: Event Type

phase.description: Restrict to one stage of the case. Must belong to the chosen event_type; the error message lists the valid values.
phase.title: Phase

until.description: Inclusive end date, YYYY-MM-DD (the whole day counts).
until.title: Until

name: scan_recent_events

outputSchema.description: Cross-company scan of one filing type within a bounded time window.

cursor.description: Continuation within the frozen effective dates; null means no next page. An expired window is an error: restart without cursor.
cursor.title: Cursor

effective_since.description: Inclusive matching filing start date actually queried, YYYY-MM-DD.
effective_since.title: Effective Since

effective_until.description: Inclusive matching filing end date actually queried, YYYY-MM-DD.
effective_until.title: Effective Until

matched_count.description: How many events matched in the whole window, before the limit was applied.
matched_count.title: Matched Count

truncated.description: True when the whole-window count exceeds this page's size, even on the last page. Only a non-null cursor means another page exists.
truncated.title: Truncated

window_clamped.description: Requested dates were intersected with the allowed recent window.
window_clamped.title: Window Clamped

outputSchema.title: ScanResult
